correctness.rationale: The independent forest-subset/path-orientation enumerator generates exactly 59,203 distinct augmented faces and the given 10-entry f-vector. A separately implemented repeated-toggle matching has 29,464 pairs and 275 critical cells; full topological sorting processes all 333,390 Hasse incidences without a cycle. Independently constructed signed critical-to-critical differentials have sizes 17x59,59x101,101x98 and compositions zero. Exact integer unimodular row/column operations yield only unit Smith factors of ranks 5,53,4 and zero residual blocks, hence no torsion; reduced ranks in degrees 4–7 are 12,1,44,94. Removing the empty-face matching gives one 0-cell and no 1/2/3-cells, yielding 3-connectivity; Hurewicz yields pi_4=Z^12. The finite enumeration is exhaustive for this one Petersen graph.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical smallest ten-vertex cubic graph of girth five. Full bidirection is a natural non-polygonal test for multipath/cycle-free partial-injection topology. Its exact integral Betti groups in four consecutive dimensions, proof of all-prime torsion-freeness, and 3-connectivity give a mathematically motivated finite invariant, not merely a routine tiny-instance check. No general graph family or wedge-of-spheres type is claimed.
